chunks: Yūnus narrated to us, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from al-Fuḍayl ibn Yasār, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

Indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, appointed ʿAlī عليه السلام as a standard between Him and His creation. So whoever recognized him was a believer, whoever denied him was a disbeliever, whoever was ignorant of him was astray, whoever set up anything alongside him was a polytheist, and whoever came with his wilayah entered Paradise.

key_terms.الْجَنَّةَ: Paradise, the abode of divine reward
key_terms.بِوَلَايَتِهِ: with his wilayah, meaning allegiance and acceptance of his divinely appointed authority
key_terms.عَلَمًا: a sign, standard, or distinguishing marker set up as guidance
key_terms.كَافِرًا: a disbeliever, one who rejects the truth being presented
key_terms.مُؤْمِنًا: a believer, one counted among the people of iman
key_terms.مُشْرِكًا: one who commits shirk by associating something alongside what Allah has established

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the significance of the wilayah of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents the wilayah of ʿAlī عليه السلام as a decisive mark of faith and guidance. It describes recognition of him as linked to iman, denial as kufr, ignorance as misguidance, and proper adherence to his wilayah as a cause for entering Jannah.
